Two blue handwritten signing marks at the bottom.
Handwritten signing initial at lower right of the agreement; handwritten date alone is not the evidence.
Handwritten signatures in both party fields and witness fields.
Handwritten signatures in the party and witness table.
Typed agreement cover and scan flecks, no signing mark.
Empty city and union signing lines; DocuSign envelope identifier alone does not count.
Typed contract template with blank fields, no handwritten signing mark.
Typed public notice and two coats of arms, no signing mark.
Typed policy text only on this page; another page may be signed.
Typed draft policy, watermark and printed seal only.
Typed form and printed emblem, no signing mark on this page.
Typed report text only.
Printed names and empty approval fields, no signing marks.
Typed board announcement, logo and printed footer only.
